subject: Culture
title: Veiling and Modesty Codes
description: One-minute skill: Veiling and Modesty Codes.

hook.text: Ancient Assyrian law required noble women to veil but banned enslaved women from doing so.

buildup.text: Veiling began as a class marker, not a religious one. Only elite women were 'worthy' of concealment.

discovery.text: Islam, Christianity, and Judaism all have veiling traditions. Paul told Corinthian women to cover their heads.

twist.text: When France banned headscarves in schools, many Muslim women wore them more defiantly as an identity statement.

climax.text: The same cloth can mean oppression or resistance depending on who controls the choice.

punchline.text: Modesty has never been about fabric alone.

quiz.question: Which ancient civilization first codified veiling laws by social class?
